# Gelabber v0.9.1

Integrated through #477, #479, #480 and #481 into `v0.9`, through #464,
#465, #466, #467, #474, #475 and #478 into `main`, and the version PR into
`main`.

Fixes for the native desktop app of 0.9.0, the web client without its
Tauri code, and dependency updates. There is no database migration, and
`.env`, `compose.yaml` and `Caddyfile` change only in their image pins.

## Desktop

- **The connection bars show the connection when you are alone (#477).**
  They read only the receiving side, which mediasoup connects when the
  first other person arrives, so alone they stayed grey. They now also read
  the sending side, as the web client does, so they show the quality as soon
  as you send anything (microphone, camera or Live). The bars and their
  tooltip now take the same round trip and loss.
- **Separators run through and are equally thin (#479).** The user panel at
  the bottom left painted over the sidebar's border, so the line between it
  and the call bar was missing on every page. At a zoom other than 100 % (the
  default text size "Standard" is 112.5 %) lines were blurred over two
  pixels and looked thicker than others. All separators are now drawn on
  whole device pixels: one pixel up to 200 %, two from there.

## Web

- **The Tauri code is gone (#480).** The web client drops the native audio
  and video bridge, global push-to-talk, the tray and notification bridge
  and the other Tauri branches (about 10,500 lines) and `@tauri-apps/api`.
  A Tauri app of 0.8.x that has not updated yet still loads the server's web
  client, but loses its desktop functions (native calls, global
  push-to-talk, tray). It keeps the notice that a new desktop app is out and
  how to get it (#468).
- `mediasoup-client` 3.26.0 (#474).

## Server

- Dependency updates (#464, #465, #466, #475): `rusty-s3` 0.11, `base64`
  0.23, `hmac` 0.13 with `sha1` 0.11 for the TURN REST credentials, `redis`
  1.8.1 and patch releases. No change in behaviour is intended; the TURN
  credential tests are unchanged and pass.

## Upgrade notes

- The image pins `GELABBER_{API,WEB,MEDIA}_IMAGE` move together to
  `v0.9.1`. The order does not matter for this release.
- **Rollback, server:** go back to the v0.9.0 image set, all three
  together. The database is unchanged.
- **Desktop, Windows:** the native app of 0.9.0 offers the update itself.
  Tauri apps from 0.7.0 on update straight to 0.9.1 through `latest.json`.
- **Desktop, Linux (Arch):** `pacman -Syu`.

## CI and repository

- apt installs in CI move to the next mirror when the runner's mirror is
  slow, instead of hitting the step's 15 minute limit (#478).
- The RNNoise model has a second download address on the repository's
  `build-deps` pre-release, pinned by the same SHA-256, because
  `media.xiph.org` was down on 2026-11-07 and every desktop build failed
  (#481).
- Dependabot's `base64` update for the desktop workspace (#467).

## Open

- The native app's own updater runs from 0.9.0 to 0.9.1 for the first time
  with this release.
- The connection bars and the separators are tested by unit and render
  tests, not yet in a real call.
- The parity reference images of the desktop scenes now show the web
  client's browser branches; the parity check is not part of CI.
